CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR'S ORDER 1 OF
1979
LAWS (CONTINUANCE IN FORCE)
(EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 10th February 1979]
In pursuance of Proclamation of the fifth day of July
1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief
Martial Law Administrator is pleased to make the following Order :‑
1.
This Order may be called the Laws (Continuance in Force) (Eighth Amendment)
Order, 1979.
2.
In the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of
1977), in Article 2, in clause (1), in the Explanation, in paragraph (a), for
the words "five years and six months" the words "six years"
shall be substituted.
